name: JSRF Unleashed
about: Jet Set Radio Future statically recompiled and running natively, drawn at up to four times the Xbox’s resolution, with 16:9 widescreen and any controller. Plays from the files of your own USA disc: Cartridge unpacks an .iso once (or uses an unpacked folder).

game.title: Jet Set Radio Future
game.why: Your own copy of the USA release: an Xbox disc image (.iso), or the folder with default.xbe and Media in it.

settings.label: Internal resolution
settings.desc: The game is drawn at this many times the Xbox’s 640x480. F9 changes it in the game (it restarts, so save first).

settings.label: Widescreen 16:9
settings.desc: A wider view, not a stretch; the HUD keeps its shape and the title screen stays 4:3. F10 in the game.

settings.label: Start full screen
settings.desc: F11 or Alt+Return switches it in the game.
